document_kind: run-spec template (Strategy C v1; instantiate to /results/<family_id>/rounds/<round_id>/attempts/<run_id>/run-spec.json BEFORE launch)

template_instantiation.rule: Domains, split, costs, gates and the selector/disposition versions are FROZEN before the first run and must be copied from the instantiated round-spec.json. Only the seven placeholders may be substituted. {{script_sha256}} must be the host-side recomputed sha256 of the deployed /scripts/40_strategy_c_run.py (contract 16.2 P10 recomputes it); the run fails closed if the deployed script does not match.

parameter_domain.decile_status: SOURCE_SPECIFIED_PRIMARY_AND_SOURCE_REPORTED_SENSITIVITY_TRACKS - the 10th percentile is the source-specified primary threshold (Memon et al. 2026: 'lower decile of the 180-day rolling mid-rank distribution'); the 5th and 20th percentile tracks are the source's own parameter-perturbation set (the wiki record's falsification item 4). Both extra tracks are registered HERE, before any computation, because contract 7.2 requires a complete strategy parameter domain rather than a single-point trial, because the card's robustness item 2 requires the three tracks to be measured, and because the registered tie-break axis order lists `decile` as a joint-space axis. A sensitivity result never replaces or redefines the primary 10th-percentile threshold (card: 'not to replace the primary'), it is only compared against it.
parameter_domain.lookback_status: SOURCE_SPECIFIED - 180 days, a singleton axis of the joint space. It is registered (not inferred) so that the neighbourhood/tie-break axis order is the registered one; it is never searched and never tuned afterwards.

dca_domain.base_quote_status: PROJECT_PRE_REGISTERED_CONSTANT - held constant across the whole domain (it is NOT a search axis) and NOT a user-fixed invariant: no operator evidence fixes it at 1000. It is a project pre-registration choice, frozen here before any computation (contract 7.2 v1.3.1).
dca_domain.spacing_pct_status: PROJECT_PRE_REGISTERED_SEARCH_DOMAIN - this axis IS searched over the registered values. The axis is a pre-registered search DOMAIN of this round, not an immutable user-fixed invariant (contract 7.2 v1.3.1).
dca_domain.size_multiplier_status: PROJECT_PRE_REGISTERED_SEARCH_DOMAIN - this axis IS searched over the registered values. The axis is a pre-registered search DOMAIN of this round, not an immutable user-fixed invariant (contract 7.2 v1.3.1).
dca_domain.breakeven_tp_pct_status: PROJECT_PRE_REGISTERED_SEARCH_DOMAIN - this axis IS searched over the registered values. The axis is a pre-registered search DOMAIN of this round, not an immutable user-fixed invariant (contract 7.2 v1.3.1).
dca_domain.invalidation_pct_status: PROJECT_PRE_REGISTERED_SEARCH_DOMAIN - this axis IS searched over the registered values. The axis is a pre-registered search DOMAIN of this round, not an immutable user-fixed invariant (contract 7.2 v1.3.1).

costs.funding_source: /data/raw funding; the evaluated configuration's registered series

gates.verdict_rule: TECHNICAL_INCOMPLETE if coverage fails; else 0 cohort survivors -> REJECT, 1 -> PASS (band SURVIVOR_FOUND). The registered family-level falsification items (threshold instability, funding provenance) forbid PASS (contract 7.2/7.3 + the card's registered battery).

round_level_outputs: rounds/<round_id>/verdict.json (written by Hermes default after the terminal readback)
falsification: coverage incomplete in any registered phase grid (G1)
OOS economic rejection (G4: annualized Sharpe < 0.40 or annualized return < 0)
cost attrition under 40 bps per fill (G8)
DCA execution incomplete / not true order-fill accounting
notes: Strategy C run-spec: the full backtest covers the registered symbol x timeframe x strategy parameter domain x DCA parameter domain over 11 phase grids, including the official-only funding-provenance rerun and the G8 cost-attrition grid. The family verdict comes from the cohort-survivor disposition (0 -> REJECT, 1 -> PASS), with the two registered family-level falsification items able to forbid PASS. The round's frozen survivor bundle is written host-side from this attempt's artifacts once it is terminally DONE (contract 10.8).
